Okay, real talk: learning to drive stick shift as an adult is absolutely humiliating. I thought it would be fun! My buddy has this old Jeep and he was like, "I'll teach you, it's easy." Lies. Complete lies. I stalled out at every single stop sign. Every. Single. One. There was this line of cars behind me at a traffic light and I could feel their judgement burning through my rearview mirror. The clutch is so confusing! You've gotta do like three things with your feet at the same time, and I can barely walk and chew gum. My buddy kept saying "you'll feel the catch point" and I'm like, what does that even mean? I felt nothing except panic and the smell of burning clutch. But I kept at it, and after about a week, something clicked. Well, more like something stopped grinding. I can actually drive it now without giving everyone whiplash. Am I smooth? Absolutely not. But hey, progress is progress!
